input.title: Redis or SQLite for the cache

input.question:
The product pages can read from Redis or from a copy of SQLite on each server. Redis answers in 41 ms and a price change clears one key, while three copies of SQLite each have to be cleared by hand.

Anyone on the storefront team can clear a key from the admin page, even without a deploy. The staging cluster already runs Redis, so nothing new has to be started, paid for or watched. Either way the page falls back to the database when the cache is down, so a wrong pick costs a slower page for an hour and nothing else. Which store should the product pages read from?

steps.say: It is up, and I asked about it.
